text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I found some rare cherry blossoms while 
taking a walk. It's deep in the mountains, 
but they're in full bloom... Hey, I know.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Let's go cherry blossom viewing together, 
Ruby. On the way back, we can grab some 
croquettes in the shopping arcade.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I am afraid I must decline your request. I 
have a jog scheduled after this, and I 
wish to refrain from consuming unmonitored 
nutrients.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Why did you call out to me today?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
You usually travel by car, right? I want 
to show you the spots you might otherwise 
miss.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
It's Ruby's birthday today, after all. 
Consider it a celebration.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...If that is the case, I believe it can 
be done without altering the schedule."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Went for a jog while exploring the 
neighborhood. After heading into the 
mountains, C.B.-san guided me on a trail 
run to the cherry blossom tree.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I will decline the croquette on the way 
back. Instead, I shall take the ham 
cutlet, which contains more protein.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. It's decided then. Now, let's go 
greet the mascot cat at the shopping 
district—
